report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN Durham City
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used as one of the key datasets to inform the development of network plans for cycling.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool, Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT), and a scoring mechanism based on effectiveness, policy alignment, economic factors, and deliverability.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has identified three priority corridors (Belmont/Carville to City Centre, Cock o’ the North to City Centre, and Gilesgate to Durham University Mountjoy campuses) for initial feasibility assessment and future investment, and will be used to support the County Council in making the case for future funding.
